<issue>
Generator inference broken after initialization changes

#### Description

Generator objects created from function calls are not properly initialized, causing inference failures when trying to access generator attributes or use them in context managers.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
import astroid

code = '''
import contextlib

@contextlib.contextmanager
def test():
    yield 42

gen = test()
with gen as value:
    pass
'''

module = astroid.parse(code)
# This will fail with AttributeError
try:
    result = next(module['value'].infer())
    print("Expected: 42, Got:", result.value)
except Exception as e:
    print("Error:", e)
```

Also fails when trying to access generator special attributes:

```python
code = '''
def test():
    yield

gen = test()
gen.__name__
'''

module = astroid.parse(code)
node = astroid.extract_node(code)
# This will fail due to None special_attributes
try:
    result = next(node.infer())
    print("Generator name:", result.value)
except Exception as e:
    print("Error:", e)
```

The issue affects contextlib.contextmanager decorated functions and regular generator functions where the Generator object cannot properly infer yield types or access special attributes.
</issue>
